glosses: To secretly cooperate with other people in order to commit a crime or other wrongdoing; to collude, to conspire.

examples.text: I might say, / That who despairs, acts; that who acts, connives / With God's relations set in time and space; [...]

glosses: Often followed by at: to pretend to be ignorant of something in order to escape blame; to ignore or overlook a fault deliberately.
